name: 郑州风云3
english_description: Zhengzhou Storm 3 (in-game banner: 'Fengyun Series: Invincible Under Heaven'), a Gu Long-style wuxia MUD founded by Xgchen ('Elder Sun Wuqing'). Shares the same 'Zhengzhou Storm' map and codebase as this collection's wqfy ('Heartless Storm', which carries the same 'Invincible Under Heaven' banner) — a relationship neither archive's documentation had previously noted. It also turns out to be a near-duplicate of this collection's other 'Zhengzhou Storm 3' archive (zzfy): same engine and map, over 10,000 files nearly all identical, differing in fewer than 200 — the two are kept as separate entries rather than merged.
